Feature: Admin Management of Labs, Chemists, Specialities, and Doctors

  @VIRTUA-4.2-4
  Scenario: Admin adds a lab and a chemist into the system
    Given the admin is logged into the system
    When the admin adds a new lab with name "Lab A"
    And the admin adds a new chemist with name "Chemist X"
    Then the system should display "Lab A" in the list of labs
    And the system should display "Chemist X" in the list of chemists

  @VIRTUA-4.2-5
  Scenario: Admin updates doctor information
    Given the admin is logged into the system
    And there is a doctor with name "Doctor Y"
    When the admin updates the doctor's name to "Doctor YY"
    Then the system should display "Doctor YY" in the list of doctors

  @Req-1/1
  Scenario Outline: Admin adds a new speciality
    Given the admin is logged into the system
    When the admin adds a new speciality with name "<speciality_name>"
    Then the system should display "<speciality_name>" in the list of specialities
    Examples:
      | speciality_name |
      | Cardiology      |
      | Dermatology     |
      | |               | # Invalid case with empty name

  @Req-1/2
  Scenario Outline: Admin views and updates the details of an existing speciality
    Given the admin is logged into the system
    And there is a speciality with name "<original_speciality_name>"
    When the admin updates the speciality name to "<updated_speciality_name>"
    Then the system should display "<updated_speciality_name>" in the list of specialities
    Examples:
      | original_speciality_name | updated_speciality_name |
      | Cardiology               | Cardiovascular          |
      | Dermatology              | Dermatology             | # No change
      | |                        | New Speciality          | # Invalid case with empty original name

  @Req-1/3
  Scenario Outline: Admin deletes a speciality
    Given the admin is logged into the system
    And there is a speciality with name "<speciality_name>"
    And there are "<number_of_doctors>" doctors associated with the speciality
    When the admin attempts to delete the speciality
    Then the system should "<expected_result>"
    Examples:
      | speciality_name | number_of_doctors | expected_result                         |
      | Cardiology      | 0                 | display a success message and remove it |
      | Dermatology     | 1                 | display an error message                |

  @Req-2
  Scenario Outline: Admin maintains doctors and associates them with a speciality
    Given the admin is logged into the system
    And there is a speciality with name "<speciality_name>"
    When the admin adds a new doctor with name "<doctor_name>" and associates with "<speciality_name>"
    Then the system should display "<doctor_name>" associated with "<speciality_name>"
    Examples:
      | speciality_name | doctor_name |
      | Cardiology      | Doctor Z    |
      | Dermatology     | Doctor ZZ   |
      | |               | Doctor ZZZ  | # Invalid case with empty speciality name

steps: the admin adds a new lab with name "Lab A"
expected: the system should display "Lab A" in the list of labs

test_cases.title: Admin adds a new chemist
preconditions: the admin is logged into the system
steps: the admin adds a new chemist with name "Chemist X"
expected: the system should display "Chemist X" in the list of chemists

test_cases.title: Admin updates doctor information
preconditions: there is a doctor with name "Doctor Y"
steps: the admin updates the doctor's name to "Doctor YY"
expected: the system should display "Doctor YY" in the list of doctors

test_cases.title: Admin adds a new speciality
preconditions: the admin is logged into the system
steps: the admin adds a new speciality with name "Cardiology"
expected: the system should display "Cardiology" in the list of specialities

test_cases.title: Admin adds a new speciality
preconditions: the admin is logged into the system
steps: the admin adds a new speciality with name "Dermatology"
expected: the system should display "Dermatology" in the list of specialities

test_cases.title: Admin adds a new speciality with empty name
preconditions: the admin is logged into the system
steps: the admin adds a new speciality with name ""
expected: the system should display "" in the list of specialities

test_cases.title: Admin updates an existing speciality
preconditions: there is a speciality with name "Cardiology"
steps: the admin updates the speciality's name to "Cardio"
expected: the system should display "Cardio" in the list of specialities

test_cases.title: Admin updates an existing speciality
preconditions: there is a speciality with name "Dermatology"
steps: the admin updates the speciality's name to "Dermato"
expected: the system should display "Dermato" in the list of specialities

test_cases.title: Admin updates an existing speciality with empty original name
preconditions: there is a speciality with name ""
steps: the admin updates the speciality's name to "NewSpeciality"
expected: the system should display "NewSpeciality" in the list of specialities

test_cases.title: Admin updates an existing speciality with empty updated name
preconditions: there is a speciality with name "NewSpeciality"
steps: the admin updates the speciality's name to ""
expected: the system should display "" in the list of specialities

test_cases.title: Admin deletes a speciality
preconditions: there is a speciality with name "Cardiology"
no doctors are associated with "Cardiology"
steps: the admin deletes the speciality with name "Cardiology"
expected: the system should not display "Cardiology" in the list of specialities

test_cases.title: Admin deletes a speciality
preconditions: there is a speciality with name "Dermatology"
no doctors are associated with "Dermatology"
steps: the admin deletes the speciality with name "Dermatology"
expected: the system should not display "Dermatology" in the list of specialities

test_cases.title: Admin attempts to delete a speciality with associated doctors
preconditions: there is a speciality with name "Cardiology"
a doctor is associated with "Cardiology"
steps: the admin deletes the speciality with name "Cardiology"
expected: the system should display an error message "Cannot delete speciality as it has associated doctors"

test_cases.title: Admin attempts to delete a speciality with associated doctors
preconditions: there is a speciality with name "Dermatology"
a doctor is associated with "Dermatology"
steps: the admin deletes the speciality with name "Dermatology"
expected: the system should display an error message "Cannot delete speciality as it has associated doctors"

test_cases.title: Admin associates a doctor with a speciality
preconditions: there is a speciality with name "Cardiology"
there is a doctor with name "Doctor A"
steps: the admin associates "Doctor A" with "Cardiology"
expected: the system should display "Doctor A" associated with "Cardiology"

test_cases.title: Admin associates a doctor with a speciality
preconditions: there is a speciality with name "Dermatology"
there is a doctor with name "Doctor B"
steps: the admin associates "Doctor B" with "Dermatology"
expected: the system should display "Doctor B" associated with "Dermatology"
